mapper.select: SELECT c.id, p.nombre, p.telefono, p.email FROM cliente c JOIN persona p ON p.id = c.persona_id WHERE c.id = #{clienteId} AND c.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pr.id, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido) AS nombre, p.telefono, pr.empresa FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id WHERE pr.id = #{proveedorId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, nombre, duracion_minutos AS duracionMinutos, precio_base AS precioBase, categoria, requiere_certificado AS requiereCertificado FROM proveedor_servicio WHERE id = #{servicioId} AND deleted = FALSE AND activo = TRUE

SELECT m.id, m.modalidad, m.costo_adicional AS costoAdicional FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE ORDER BY m.modalidad

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.modalidad = #{modalidad} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE
SELECT m.id, m.nombre, m.cliente_id AS clienteId, e.nombre AS especie FROM mascota m LEFT JOIN especie e ON e.id = m.especie_id AND e.deleted = FALSE WHERE m.id = #{mascotaId} AND m.deleted = FALSE
